title: Molecular Docking and In Vivo Biological Studies of Sodium Salt of 3-(4-Methyl-2-oxo-2-H-quinoline-7-yloxy)-3-phenylacrylic Acid As Anticancer Agent.
authors: Mohamed, Faten Z; Eid, Sarah A; Elghareb, Mohamed S; Abas, Al-Shimaa M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究喹啉衍生物钠盐的体内抗癌活性，仅用分子对接初步验证与小分子-蛋白结合，核心是湿实验药效评估，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，方法深度不足。
abstract: Quinoline derivatives possess several therapeutic properties. Aim: studying the anticancer effect of 3-(4-methyl-2-oxo-2-H-quinoline-7-yloxy)-3-phenylacrylic acid's sodium solution on the Ehrlich ascites carcinoma (EAC). Median lethal dose (LD(50)) and dose response curve was determined for sodium salt solution of 3-(4-methyl-2-oxo-2-H-quinoline-7-yloxy)-3-phenylacrylic acid, then diving a group of one hundred Swiss albino mice, which are all females, into five groups: group 1: (negative control) where intraperitoneally injected with saline into mice for 10 successive days; group 2 (positive control), also namely (EAC-bearing group): where the EAC cells were intraperitoneally injected into mice (2.5 x 10(6) cells/mouse) only one time on the first day; group 3 which is defined as the (therapeutic group) where the Na(+) salt of the synthetic compound was injected into the peritoneum of the mice (2.5 mg/kg) the very first day after the injection of the EAC, then the compound was injected every two days for a period of 10 days; group 4 which is the (preventive group) where the sodium salt of the synthetic compound (2.5 mg/kg) was injected in the peritoneum of the mice the day before the injection of the EAC, then the compound was successively injected every day for a period of ten days; and group 5 which is the (drug group) in which mice were repeatedly injected) in their peritoneum with the sodium salt of the synthetic compound (2.5 mg/kg on a daily basis over a period of ten days. On the eleventh day of the trial, EAC cells were harvested from each mouse in a heparinized saline, in addition to blood samples, liver and kidney tissues which are also collected. Molecular docking showed that compound's sodium salt was docked into (PDB: 2R7G) and (PDB: 2R3I), which are the retinoblastoma protein receptor and the cyclin D-1 receptor respectively. Compared to those in the positive control group, mice in both the therapeutic and preventive groups, has shown a significant decrease in MDA, cyclin D-1 levels in the tissues of both liver and kidney tissues, in addition to the serum ALT, AST, CK-MB, and LDH activities, and the serum urea and creatinine concentration. However, mice in the formerly mentioned groups, both therapeutic and preventive groups, have shown an increase in the serum albumin, total protein, retinoblastoma protein in both liver and kidney tissues as well as the total antioxidant capacity, when compared to mice in the positive control group. It is worth mentioning that histopathological findings have confirmed that. Sodium salt of 3-(4-methyl-2-oxo-2H-quinoline-7-yloxy)-3-phenylacrylic acid showed potential in vivo anticancer and antioxidant effects against Ehrlich ascites carcinoma cells; (EAC cells).
abstract_zh: 喹啉衍生物具有多种治疗特性。目的：研究3-(4-甲基-2-氧代-2H-喹啉-7-氧基)-3-苯基丙烯酸钠溶液对艾氏腹水癌（EAC）的抗癌作用。测定了3-(4-甲基-2-氧代-2H-喹啉-7-氧基)-3-苯基丙烯酸钠盐溶液的中位致死剂量（LD(50)）和剂量反应曲线，然后将一百只瑞士白化小鼠（均为雌性）分为五组：第1组：（阴性对照），每天腹腔注射生理盐水，连续10天；第2组（阳性对照），也称为（EAC荷瘤组）：仅在第一天腹腔注射EAC细胞（2.5 x 10(6)个细胞/只）一次；第3组定义为（治疗组），在注射EAC后的第一天，将合成化合物的Na(+)盐注入小鼠腹腔（2.5 mg/kg），然后每隔两天注射一次该化合物，持续10天；第4组为（预防组），在注射EAC前一天，将合成化合物的钠盐（2.5 mg/kg）注入小鼠腹腔，然后每天连续注射该化合物，持续10天；第5组为（药物组），小鼠每天腹腔注射合成化合物的钠盐（2.5 mg/kg），持续10天。在试验的第11天，从每只小鼠中采集EAC细胞于肝素化盐水中，同时收集血液样本、肝脏和肾脏组织。分子对接显示，该化合物的钠盐对接至（PDB: 2R7G）和（PDB: 2R3I），分别为视网膜母细胞瘤蛋白受体和细胞周期蛋白D-1受体。与阳性对照组相比，治疗组和预防组的小鼠在肝脏和肾脏组织中的MDA、细胞周期蛋白D-1水平显著降低，同时血清ALT、AST、CK-MB和LDH活性以及血清尿素和肌酐浓度也显著降低。然而，前述两组（即治疗组和预防组）的小鼠在血清白蛋白、总蛋白、肝脏和肾脏组织中的视网膜母细胞瘤蛋白以及总抗氧化能力方面均有所增加，与阳性对照组相比。值得一提的是，组织病理学发现证实了这一点。3-(4-甲基-2-氧代-2H-喹啉-7-氧基)-3-苯基丙烯酸钠盐对艾氏腹水癌细胞（EAC细胞）显示出潜在的体内抗癌和抗氧化作用。
